evidence.text:
2028 Fees and Refund Guide
Section: Harbour Lantern Dance Studio: 2028 fees and refunds


# Harbour Lantern Dance Studio: 2028 fees and refunds

Term fees are due on 2 February 2028 for Term One.
The sibling discount is 10 percent on the second child's term tuition, excluding costumes and transport.
A withdrawal request must reach the office by 5 pm on 19 January 2028 for a full Term One tuition refund.
After that deadline, a teacher must review any refund request; no refund amount is guaranteed.
The $35 costume deposit is refundable only when the hired costume is returned within seven calendar days of the performance, clean and undamaged.
The costume deposit rule does not apply to trial workshop fees.
A payment receipt may be requested from the office, but this guide does not show whether a family has paid.
A scholarship application does not pause the term fee deadline.
The annual registration fee is $18 per student and is not discounted for siblings.
evidence.prefix:
2028 Fees and Refund Guide
Section: Harbour Lantern Dance Studio: 2028 fees and refunds

evidence.text:
2028 Absence and Credit Note
Section: Harbour Lantern Dance Studio: absence and credits


# Harbour Lantern Dance Studio: absence and credits

An ordinary absence reported at least 18 hours before class may earn one replacement lesson credit.
Illness reported after that cutoff needs teacher review and does not automatically earn a credit.
Replacement lesson credits expire 60 calendar days after the missed class.
A credit cannot be exchanged for cash or used for the winter intensive.
A teacher must confirm a replacement lesson before the booking changes.
The absence form records a request, not a confirmed replacement place.
The policy does not state whether a particular student currently has an unused credit.
evidence.prefix:
2028 Absence and Credit Note
Section: Harbour Lantern Dance Studio: absence and credits

evidence.text:
2028 Performance Handbook
Section: Harbour Lantern Dance Studio: performance handbook


# Harbour Lantern Dance Studio: performance handbook

The Harbour Festival rehearsal is on 4 August 2028 at 16:00 in Pier Hall.
Performers must arrive 30 minutes before the Harbour Festival rehearsal.
A performer may use a plain navy leotard if a hired costume is unavailable, after the teacher confirms suitability.
Festival photography consent must be filed by 20 July 2028.
A family may decline photography without losing its performance place.
The performance shuttle leaves Lantern Hall at 14:40 on 11 August 2028.
The shuttle return time depends on the event finish and is not fixed in this handbook.
The performance takes place on 11 August 2028 at Seafarer Theatre.
A costume must be returned to the office desk, not the theatre, after the performance.
evidence.prefix:
2028 Performance Handbook
Section: Harbour Lantern Dance Studio: performance handbook

evidence.text:
2028 Family Welcome Note
Section: Harbour Lantern Dance Studio: family welcome note


# Harbour Lantern Dance Studio: family welcome note

For an ordinary absence, please notify the studio at least 24 hours before class to request a replacement lesson credit.
The note does not say whether it supersedes the 2028 Absence and Credit Note.
Families may email the office with a class date and student name.
The office does not approve replacement bookings through this note.
evidence.prefix:
2028 Family Welcome Note
Section: Harbour Lantern Dance Studio: family welcome note

evidence.text:
2028 Workshop Guide
Section: Harbour Lantern Dance Studio: 2028 workshop guide


# Harbour Lantern Dance Studio: 2028 workshop guide

A beginner may join the Saturday Contemporary Lab from age 12.
The Saturday Contemporary Lab meets at 10:30 at Pier Hall.
The Tuesday Ballet Foundations class meets at 17:15 at Lantern Hall.
A trial workshop costs $24 and must be booked by a teacher.
Trial fees are credited against the first term invoice only if enrolment occurs within 14 calendar days after the trial.
A family may observe one beginner class free of charge if the teacher confirms space.
Workshop places are not guaranteed by a published timetable.
A child under 12 cannot attend the Saturday Contemporary Lab without a teacher-approved exception.
The winter intensive runs from 8 July to 12 July 2028.
The winter intensive registration form closes on 21 June 2028.
evidence.prefix:
2028 Workshop Guide
Section: Harbour Lantern Dance Studio: 2028 workshop guide

evidence.text:
2028 Access and Transport Note
Section: Harbour Lantern Dance Studio: access and transport


# Harbour Lantern Dance Studio: access and transport

Pier Hall has a step-free entrance on Quay Lane.
The accessible bathroom at Pier Hall is beside Studio B.
Lantern Hall's side entrance closes at 18:00 on weekdays.
A family needing a quiet waiting area should ask the office before arrival; use is subject to availability.
The Saturday shuttle from Quay Lane to Lantern Hall departs at 09:20.
The Saturday shuttle does not run during school holidays.
Shuttle tickets cost $6 per single ride and must be reserved by the office.
The Quay Lane drop-off bay has a five-minute limit.
